column1: # Game, map and project content used by the dev setup and the release packager.
#   source  git URL, "local" (exists only in a local checkout for now) or
#           "download" (a prebuilt archive that has to be placed manually)
#   branch  branch to check out ("-" for non-git sources)
#   ship    yes/no: whether release/package.sh puts it in the bundle
# Public game branches: master for Lua, rust for WASM.
# Packaging always uses whatever is checked out locally.
